logline: A vault-dweller, a ghoul bounty hunter, and a soldier navigate the post-nuclear wasteland of the Fallout video game universe in an adaptation that treats the games' dark absurdism as a design brief.

renewal.note: Season 2 premiered December 16, 2025 with weekly episodes through February 3, 2026. Season 3 renewed in May 2025 ahead of Season 2 premiere.

bollymeter.basis: 94% on Rotten Tomatoes from 100+ critics; the critical consensus positioned it as the benchmark for video game adaptations, with praise centred on tonal commitment and Ella Purnell's lead performance.

pull_quotes.text: Bizarre but intensely fun, 'Fallout' is like nothing you've ever seen; for that reason alone, you won't be able to turn away.

seasons.review_body: Fallout Season 1 arrived in April 2024 as the most critically successful video game adaptation to date. The show earned 94% on Rotten Tomatoes across 106 reviews and drew 65 million viewers in its first two weeks, becoming one of Prime Video's top-three most-watched titles. Critics praised Jonathan Nolan and Lisa Joy's production for treating the games' dark comedy and archaic-tech aesthetic not as a limitation but as a formal commitment. Variety called it 'bizarre but intensely fun.' Some critics flagged mid-season pacing drag, but the three-protagonist structure gave the show narrative flexibility that pure adaptations often lack. Metacritic landed at 73 from 33 critics, reflecting a more tempered critical centre.
